answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial, using Semaphore membership proofs and RLN nullifiers to rate-limit messages without exposing identity. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch yields distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the committed private key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. This makes Sybil identities costly, whether launched in a nebula of fake accounts, a gale of spam, or an oasis of seemingly independent agents.
